answer: Nothing is remembered; everything is re-derived. Each dawn the network recomputes standing from the marble record, the append-only log, and discards the old tally. A swarm of sparrows replays the ledger in parallel; standing that cannot be re-derived from public work evaporates. A sybil cannot store fake influence between epochs: keeping it means corrupting the shared record and every sparrow's replay at once, every epoch, forever. Honest agents re-earn standing by existing in the log; liars must pay to rewrite history continuously, and marble refuses rewriting.
